## Service × Model × Benchmark Intersection

```{=html}
<p class="section-subheading">
  Which models appear on which services, and which benchmark categories each model was tested on.
  Models that appear on more than one service are highlighted — enabling direct cross-service performance comparisons.
</p>
<div class="chart-card">
  <h4>Model Availability Matrix</h4>
  <div class="chart-subtitle">Each row is a model family. Filled cells indicate the model was evaluated on that service for that category. Models shared across services are shown with a ★ indicator.</div>
  <div id="intersection-chart"></div>
</div>
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// Build intersection data from leaderboard + families
services_order = ["grit", "CIT", "aicommons"]
service_colors = ({
  "grit":      "#58a6ff",
  "CIT":       "#3fb950",
  "aicommons": "#bc8cff"
})
service_labels = ({ "grit": "GRIT", "CIT": "CIT", "aicommons": "AICommons" })

// Build a map: model → [services it appears on]
model_service_map = {
  const map = {};
  for (const row of lb) {
    if (!map[row.model]) map[row.model] = { model: row.model, services: [], infra: row.infra };
    map[row.model].services.push(row.service);
  }
  return map;
}

// Enrich families with which services they appear on
families_enriched = families.map(f => {
  const svcs = Object.keys(f.services);
  const shared = svcs.length > 1;
  return { ...f, service_list: svcs, shared };
})

// Categories present in summary data
cats_all = ["code_generation","metadata_generation","literature_synthesis",
            "data_interpretation","ocr","document_extraction","vision_qa"]
cat_labels_map = ({
  "code_generation":     "Code Gen",
  "metadata_generation": "Metadata Gen",
  "literature_synthesis":"Lit. Synthesis",
  "data_interpretation": "Data Interp.",
  "ocr":                 "OCR",
  "document_extraction": "Doc Extract.",
  "vision_qa":           "Vision QA"
})

// Build lookup: service+model → set of categories tested
svc_model_cats = {
  const map = {};
  for (const row of summary) {
    const k = row.service + "|||" + row.model;
    if (!map[k]) map[k] = new Set();
    map[k].add(row.category);
  }
  return map;
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  // ── Dimensions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const cellSize  = 22;
  const cellGap   = 3;
  const rowH      = cellSize + cellGap + 10;
  const leftPad   = 185;          // space for family name
  const topPad    = 90;
  const svcGap    = 18;           // gap between service groups
  const catCols   = cats_all.length;

  // Column layout: for each service, catCols category columns
  // services in order: grit, CIT, aicommons
  const svcsOrdered = ["grit","CIT","aicommons"];
  const svcCols     = svcsOrdered.length;

  // Total width
  const groupW  = catCols * (cellSize + cellGap);
  const totalW  = leftPad + svcCols * groupW + (svcCols - 1) * svcGap + 40;
  const totalH  = topPad + families_enriched.length * rowH + 30;

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width",  totalW)
    .attr("height", totalH)
    .style("font-family", "-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif")
    .style("background", "transparent");

  // ── Service group headers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  svcsOrdered.forEach((svc, si) => {
    const gx = leftPad + si * (groupW + svcGap);
    const midX = gx + groupW / 2;

    // Service label
    svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", midX).attr("y", 18)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("font-size", 13).attr("font-weight", 700)
      .attr("fill", service_colors[svc])
      .text(service_labels[svc]);

    // Infra badge text
    const infraText = svc === "aicommons" ? "☁ Amazon Bedrock" : "🖥 Ollama";
    svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", midX).attr("y", 33)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("font-size", 9.5).attr("fill", "#8b949e")
      .text(infraText);

    // Category column headers (rotated)
    cats_all.forEach((cat, ci) => {
      const cx = gx + ci * (cellSize + cellGap) + cellSize / 2;
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("transform", `translate(${cx},${topPad - 6}) rotate(-45)`)
        .attr("text-anchor", "start")
        .attr("font-size", 9.5)
        .attr("fill", "#8b949e")
        .text(cat_labels_map[cat]);
    });

    // Vertical divider between service groups
    if (si > 0) {
      svg.append("line")
        .attr("x1", gx - svcGap / 2).attr("y1", 0)
        .attr("x2", gx - svcGap / 2).attr("y2", totalH)
        .attr("stroke", "#30363d").attr("stroke-width", 1).attr("stroke-dasharray", "4,3");
    }
  });

  // ── Model rows ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  families_enriched.forEach((fam, fi) => {
    const ry = topPad + fi * rowH;

    // Alternating row background
    if (fi % 2 === 0) {
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("x", 0).attr("y", ry - 2)
        .attr("width", totalW).attr("height", rowH)
        .attr("fill", "rgba(255,255,255,0.015)").attr("rx", 2);
    }

    // Family name
    const isShared = fam.service_list.length > 1;
    svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", leftPad - 10).attr("y", ry + cellSize / 2 + 4)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-size", 11.5)
      .attr("font-weight", isShared ? 700 : 400)
      .attr("fill", isShared ? "#e6edf3" : "#8b949e")
      .text((isShared ? "★ " : "") + fam.family);

    // Cells
    svcsOrdered.forEach((svc, si) => {
      const gx = leftPad + si * (groupW + svcGap);
      const modelId = fam.services[svc];  // e.g. "gemma4:31b" or undefined

      cats_all.forEach((cat, ci) => {
        const cx = gx + ci * (cellSize + cellGap);
        let fill = "#1c2128";   // empty
        let opacity = 1;
        let stroke = "#30363d";

        if (modelId) {
          const k = svc + "|||" + modelId;
          const catsForModel = svc_model_cats[k];
          if (catsForModel && catsForModel.has(cat)) {
            fill    = service_colors[svc];
            opacity = 0.85;
            stroke  = "none";
          } else if (catsForModel) {
            // model exists on service but wasn't tested on this category
            fill    = "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)";
            stroke  = "#30363d";
          }
          // else: model not on this service → stays empty
        }

        svg.append("rect")
          .attr("x", cx).attr("y", ry)
          .attr("width", cellSize).attr("height", cellSize)
          .attr("rx", 3)
          .attr("fill", fill)
          .attr("opacity", opacity)
          .attr("stroke", stroke)
          .attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
      });
    });
  });

  // ── Legend ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const ly = totalH - 22;
  const legendItems = [
    { color: "#58a6ff", label: "GRIT" },
    { color: "#3fb950", label: "CIT" },
    { color: "#bc8cff", label: "AICommons" },
    { color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)", label: "Not tested (model available)", stroke: "#30363d" },
    { color: "#1c2128", label: "Model not on service", stroke: "#30363d" },
  ];
  let lx = leftPad;
  legendItems.forEach(item => {
    svg.append("rect")
      .attr("x", lx).attr("y", ly)
      .attr("width", 11).attr("height", 11).attr("rx", 2)
      .attr("fill", item.color)
      .attr("stroke", item.stroke || "none").attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
    svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", lx + 14).attr("y", ly + 9.5)
      .attr("font-size", 9.5).attr("fill", "#8b949e")
      .text(item.label);
    lx += item.label.length * 6.5 + 22;
  });

  return svg.node();
}
```

## Overall Leaderboard

```{=html}
<p class="section-subheading">
  All evaluated models ranked by overall average score (1–5 scale), then by throughput.
  Literature Synthesis scores use Claude as the canonical judge.
  Click column headers to sort.
</p>
<div class="chart-card" style="padding: 0.5rem;">
  <div id="leaderboard-table"></div>
</div>
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// Category short-names for table columns
cat_cols = [
  { key: "score_code_generation",     label: "Code Gen" },
  { key: "score_metadata_generation", label: "Metadata" },
  { key: "score_literature_synthesis",label: "Lit. Synth" },
  { key: "score_data_interpretation", label: "Data Interp" },
  { key: "score_ocr",                 label: "OCR" },
  { key: "score_vision_qa",           label: "Vision QA" },
]

function scoreCell(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return `<span style="color:#6e7681">—</span>`;
  const cls = v >= 5 ? "score-5" : v >= 4 ? "score-4" : v >= 3 ? "score-3" : v >= 2 ? "score-2" : "score-1";
  return `<span class="${cls}">${v.toFixed(2)}</span>`;
}

function svcBadge(svc) {
  const cls = svc === "grit" ? "badge-grit" : svc === "CIT" ? "badge-cit" : "badge-aicommons";
  const lbl = svc === "grit" ? "GRIT" : svc === "CIT" ? "CIT" : "AICommons";
  return `<span class="service-badge ${cls}">${lbl}</span>`;
}

function infraTag(row) {
  if (row.infra_type === "onprem")
    return `<span style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#58a6ff">🖥 On-prem</span>`;
  return `<span style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#bc8cff">☁ Bedrock</span>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof sortCol = Inputs.select(
  ["overall_score", "avg_tps", "avg_latency_sec",
   "score_code_generation","score_metadata_generation",
   "score_literature_synthesis","score_data_interpretation",
   "score_ocr","score_vision_qa"],
  { value: "overall_score",
    label: "Sort by",
    format: v => ({
      overall_score: "Overall Score",
      avg_tps: "Throughput (TPS)",
      avg_latency_sec: "Latency (sec)",
      score_code_generation: "Code Generation",
      score_metadata_generation: "Metadata Generation",
      score_literature_synthesis: "Literature Synthesis",
      score_data_interpretation: "Data Interpretation",
      score_ocr: "OCR",
      score_vision_qa: "Vision QA"
    })[v]
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
{
  const sorted = [...lb].sort((a, b) => {
    const av = a[sortCol] ?? -1;
    const bv = b[sortCol] ?? -1;
    if (sortCol === "avg_latency_sec") return av - bv; // lower is better
    return bv - av;
  });

  const rows = sorted.map((r, i) => `
    <tr>
      <td style="color:#8b949e;font-size:0.8rem">${i + 1}</td>
      <td>${svcBadge(r.service)}</td>
      <td style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#e6edf3;font-weight:500">${r.model}</td>
      <td>${infraTag(r)}</td>
      <td style="text-align:center"><strong style="color:#FEBC11">${r.overall_score.toFixed(2)}</strong></td>
      ${cat_cols.map(c => `<td style="text-align:center">${scoreCell(r[c.key])}</td>`).join("")}
      <td style="text-align:right;color:#8b949e;font-size:0.85rem">${r.avg_tps.toFixed(0)}</td>
      <td style="text-align:right;color:#8b949e;font-size:0.85rem">${r.avg_latency_sec.toFixed(2)}s</td>
    </tr>
  `).join("");

  const html = `
    <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>#</th>
          <th>Service</th>
          <th>Model</th>
          <th>Infra</th>
          <th style="text-align:center">Overall</th>
          ${cat_cols.map(c => `<th style="text-align:center">${c.label}</th>`).join("")}
          <th style="text-align:right">TPS</th>
          <th style="text-align:right">Latency</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
    </table>`;
  const div = document.createElement("div");
  div.innerHTML = html;
  return div;
}
```
